# Bits and Pieces

> A publication dedicated to composable software development, component-driven architecture, and modern web development practices.

Bits and Pieces is a developer-focused blog covering React, component libraries, software composition, and best practices in contemporary web development. The platform fosters community engagement through shared technical content and developer collaboration.

## Key Topics

- React
- Component-driven development
- Composable software
- Web development
- Bit.dev
- AWS
- Developer community
- Software architecture
- Code reusability
- Modern development practices
- Tech content
- Data visualization
- Publication
- Developer collaboration

## Core Content

- [Bits and Pieces](https://blog.bitsrc.io): Main blog homepage with articles on composable software development and component-driven architecture

## Topic Archives

- [Data Visualization Tools](https://blog.bitsrc.io/all?topic=data-visualization-tools): Filtered blog archive for data visualization tools topic articles
